notes: 188 cells (8 and 60 respondents; 15/30 items; random, first, favourite, salience, dissent; seed bases 2000 and 50000; 40 surveys each). Shipped, first-flag, drop schemes and oracle-drop match the capped files in all 69 + 48 overlapping cells. Uncapped loo-w: camp tax -0.017 to -0.052 (8) and -0.020 to -0.059 (60, 25-40% camps), was about half; gains up to +0.114 vs coin flippers. New: at 60 people loo-w makes a 25-40% camp's pool call 0.9-1.7% of clear pairs wrong (shipped 0-0.03%). Decision unchanged: agreement stays a note. certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
